newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Oct 31.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Oct 31.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company
GUNS FOR SALE: SAS MEN HELD
Scotland Yard's Organised Crime Group arrested six soldiers from the SAS and Parachute Regiment for questioning over illegal sales of Army guns.

Bill Glover, who set up Hong Kong-based Matheson PFC, is to form an action group of investors demanding compensation from Jardine Fleming for losses blamed on Colin Armstrong, a disgraced former director who siphoned-off profits from funds.

The board of Discovery Petroleum have rejected Premier Oil's second bid, which Premier increased from 70 cents a shares to 80 cents a share. Discovery believes its value is still larger because of its future potential and its strategic importance to Premier.
LADBROKE READY TO ROLL WITH SPREAD BETS
The Securities and Futures Association is expected to give Ladbroke the green light soon for its new Ladbroke Index spread betting operation, which will concentrate solely on sports spread betting.
TAXI DRIVERS RATTLED BY COM CAB FUNDS DRIVE

London cabbies are unhappy that directors of Computer Cab, the network owned by the 5,000-member Licensed Taxi Drivers' Association, are planning to sell shares in the company without offering free shares or cash to the drivers who presently own it.
